lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, with the largest and most intense spots located in the mid-lateral section of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spot centroids, creating a visible grid-like coordinate system on the flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible across the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 distinct high-luminance blobs visible on the leading and lateral surface of the dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular/loop-shaped scar or depigmentation pattern is visible on the mid-lateral flank, immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, large, non-standard U-shaped pixel arrangement of higher luminance located in the center of the grid pattern on the left lateral flank.
